outline: Theoretical and computational aspects of finite element method include rod, beam, frame, triangular and quadrilateral elements, assembly process, solution techniques, iso-parametric formulation, and plane stress applications. Program development and modification are expected as well as learning the use of existing codes.
schedule:
W1-W3. Introduction to finite element analysis software
W4-W6. Introduction to the finite element method
W7-W9. Application in structural analysis
W10-W12. Review of three dimensional linear elasticity
W13-W15. Finite element solution of two dimensional elasticity problems
W16-W18. Higher order and mapped elements in two and three dimensions
assessment:
Activity in class: 25% +/- 5%
Midterm with aids from AI:  25% +/- 5%
Final project: 50%  +/- 10%
